name: Notible Teams
description: Test version: share a project with a few people through the Notible Teams server. It is encrypted on your computer before it leaves.
author: Notible
guide:
This is a test version for a small group of invited people.

Open **Settings → Plugins → Notible Teams**, sign in, and choose a project to share. The people you invite see it in their own Notible. Everything is encrypted on your computer before it is sent.
